english_outline: 1. Main conclusion: Reuters reports Cisco guided annual revenue above estimates, citing sustained AI spending. 2. Core business change: AI-driven demand is the stated driver of the guidance; official filing confirms full-fiscal-year revenue of USD 63.325bn, operating income USD 15.368bn, net income USD 13.267bn, operating cash flow USD 14.177bn for FY2026 (2025-07-27 to 2026-07-25). 3. Expectation change: higher revenue outlook implies growth expectations rise; margin and cash-flow implications are not specified by sources, so omit. 4. Market pricing: Reuters headline frames the guidance as above estimates; no verified share-price move or named analyst target is available, so state only the reported above-estimates framing and note absence of named institutional divergence. 5. Next-quarter verification point: whether AI-related order momentum sustains the revenue trajectory implied by the annual guidance.
reader_questions: 稿件把633.25亿美元等四个数字当作“2026财年全年”口径使用，但SEC原始文件是否确实覆盖2025-07-27至2026-07-25这一整年，而非某一季度？
稿件称“路透社将思科年度收入指引的上调直接归因于人工智能支出的延续”，但所附路透社与MarketScreener、Investing.com的摘录均为空，这一归因是否有可核实的来源支撑？
稿件说“市场报道所反映的共识被上修”，但材料中没有任何可核实的预期数字或机构观点，这一表述能否成立？
checks: 核对SEC原始文件：四个数字均标注为2025-07-27至2026-07-25的全年口径，US GAAP标签分别为RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax、OperatingIncomeLoss、NetIncomeLoss、NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities，与稿件表述一致，保留但需明确“全年”限定。
核对市场报道：三条链接的标题均指向“Cisco forecasts annual revenue above estimates on sustained AI spending”，但所附article_excerpt与search_excerpt均为空，无法核实“上调”“直接归因”等措辞，稿件应改为仅陈述标题所载事实，删除“上调”与“直接归因”的强化表述。
核对定价部分：材料中没有股价、评级、目标价或具名机构观点，稿件中“共识被上修”“通常对应正面反应”均无来源支撑，应删除，仅保留“标题显示指引高于预期”这一可核实事实。
